payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for different models used in cyberbullying detection, including the impact of oversampling on DNN models and a comparison with traditional machine learning models.

claims.text: Oversampling bullying posts improved the performance of DNN models significantly across all evaluation measures.
Traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) performed significantly lower than DNN models in cyberbullying detection.
The smallest dataset (Formspring) benefited the most from oversampling, improving its performance due to the low number of bullying instances.
